typography.font_family_primary: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist - Radical weight contrast (Black vs Regular), tight letter spacing

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Ensure containers with borders have internal padding.
layout.grid_strategy: The Tetris Grid (Mode A). Focus on asymmetry, bento layouts, and leaving empty cells for offset alignment.
layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px max) to maintain the Swiss high-contrast sharp aesthetic.
layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and paragraphs. Headings can be left-aligned for an editorial feel.

surfaces.header: Solid Background (White) with a hard bottom border (border-b border-[#E5E5E5]) to ground the navigation.
surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no soft drop shadows. Use hard inner contrasts.
surfaces.footer: Contrast Shift: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) background, stark white text, massive typographic CTA.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Primary CTA (Webinar) in Black. WhatsApp CTA in Accent Green (#25D366). Use explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-800 hover:text-white).
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but heavily customize. Remove the default rounded-md for rounded-none. Inputs should have 1px solid black border on focus.
components.navigation: Visible links on desktop (no hamburger on desktop). Sticky header with z-50. Include both CTAs in the nav.
components.mobile_sticky_cta: A fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports with 'Join Webinar' and 'WhatsApp' buttons.

motion.hover_states: Crisp transformations. -translate-y-1 with solid block shadow, or simple high-contrast color inversion.
motion.page_transitions: Minimalist. Staggered fade-ins for bento grid items.

images.description: Indian student using laptop on bench
Group of people in a white room (startup meetup vibe)
Black app sign on white wall to act as a placeholder for company logos

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-whatsapp-btn', data-testid='webinar-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for the SF Pro (-apple-system) font stack. Use strong weight contrast (e.g., font-black for headings, font-normal for body) to build hierarchy without color.
Maintain strict monochrome (black/white/gray) for the entire UI. The ONLY color permitted is the WhatsApp Green (#25D366) for WhatsApp-related CTAs.
Apply the Tailwind `grayscale` utility class to ALL images to ensure they match the monochrome aesthetic, allowing them to blend seamlessly with the Swiss Brutalist layout.
Build a pure HTML/Tailwind high-conversion marketing layout for the Home page, avoiding default Shadcn container styles. Use asymmetric bento grids (Mode A).
Implement a sticky mobile CTA bar at the bottom of the screen (visible only on sm/md viewports) offering 'Join Free Webinar' and 'Join WhatsApp Community'.
For the Mentorship Inquiry form, include a Hindi-friendly confirmation message (e.g., 'Shukriya! Hum jaldi aapse connect karenge.') upon successful submission.
Ensure the Webinar registration form captures Name, Email, Phone, College, and Interested Role (dropdown) and displays a success state directing to the WhatsApp community.
